subject: Multimodal Annotation for Content Understanding
text:

to reach out for a quick chat. We've been working on content classification
projects with DoubleVerify, GumGum and Zefr, naturally IAS has been on our

models for auto-labelling & ensure effective QA with human feedback.

Let me know if you're open to exchange perspectives? Quite flexible
Tuesdays to Thursdays if you have a preferred time.

subject: Video-Native Curation & Annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded a video surveillance company who moved from in-house
tools, mentioning before they struggled to efficiently filter & select
videos from specific viewpoints, camera types or by quality for edge cases
annotation. So I wonder how you're thinking about this at ECAM, esp. given
the scale and diversity of your deployments?

In case Encord is new to you - we work with Milestone Systems, Flock
Safety, and LVT to ensure dataset representativeness and speed up
annotation with video-native object tracking and event captioning. That's
been key in helping surface actionable events more accurately for human
intervention.

Keen to hear how you're approaching this? Quite flexible Tues to Thurs if
you're open to a chat.

subject: Long tail problem for AV data
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Woven by Toyota, who previously lacked a consistent
way to find rare events across millions of miles of driving data. This led
to duplicated engineering efforts and siloed custom tools being built and
maintained across different teams. I wonder if that resonates with the
challenges you've encountered, esp as your self-driving cars are being
tested in Austin?

In case Encord is new to you - our platform helps autonomous driving teams
like Woven search and filter for long-tail scenarios, while unifying data
curation, annotation, and model evaluation workflows across the
organization. This has been key to standardizing processes and tracking
productivity, as data requirements constantly evolve.

Keen to hear how you're thinking about this at [COMPANY]? I'm flexible
Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to a quick chat.
